status_note: the pin is the head of the fork branch cards/precon-commander-decks (moeendres-png/mage, draft PR #71): the v12 pin 4da83f62 plus two commits that build ten Commander precon cards for real, each with Mage.Tests cases: Winter, Cynical Opportunist; Zinnia, Valley's Voice; Aminatou, Veil Piercer; Jace, Multiverse Architect; Dack Fayden, Helping Hand; Jhoira, Weatherlight Corsair; Tamiyo, Upriser Crowned; Teferi's Reproach; The Ur-Sphinx; Venser, Fervent Forger (Lab #979).
